61.30164,41.19992.name: Янги клиника
61.30164,41.19992.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

2.21000,46.23000.name: Sanofi Vaccines, France
2.21000,46.23000.state: ALBA LA ROMAINE, MARCY L'ÉTOILE AND VAL DE REUIL, FRANCE
2.21000,46.23000.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Sanofi Vaccines. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The city could not be resolved, so this sits at the centre of the country. It is not a location.

-96.34560,30.61839.name: Texas A&M University
-96.34560,30.61839.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-0.14749,51.51903.name: Evewell Harley Street
-0.14749,51.51903.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

19.09149,47.47696.name: National Biosafety Laboratory (NBL)
19.09149,47.47696.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by Ministry of Human capacities. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-77.10500,39.00900.name: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committees — OLAW
-77.10500,39.00900.desc: The US committees that approve animal research protocols at each institution, composed largely of that institution's own scientists plus a veterinarian and at least one member from outside. Self-regulation of this kind is the entire approval layer for most animal work in the United States — the Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare oversees the system rather than the protocols — and committee records are not public unless a request forces them out.

-117.24300,32.88800.name: Scripps Research — expanded genetic alphabet
-117.24300,32.88800.state: La Jolla, California — 10550 North Torrey Pines Road
-117.24300,32.88800.desc: Built bacteria carrying a synthetic base pair beyond the natural four, and got them to copy it and make proteins from it. An organism using a genetic code no other living thing shares cannot exchange genes with anything, which is both a containment strategy and a step toward life that is not related to ours.
